idea-plugin.name: Checksum & Regex Playground
idea-plugin.description:
Checksum & Regex Playground

A tool window for QA / fintech / KYC engineers. Paste any identifier and instantly see which real-world checks it passes — no browser, no guesswork, fully offline.

  • Checksums tab: type or paste a value and it live-validates against every applicable algorithm — IBAN (ISO 7064 mod-97), card Luhn, VAT (DE/GB/CY/NL), Dutch BSN, AU TFN/ABN, BIC/SWIFT structure, GB NINo, German ID card (ICAO 7-3-1). Each check shows ✔ pass or ✘ fail.
  • Regex tab: a live regular-expression tester — pattern + text → matches with capture groups and positions, with clear syntax-error messages.

Open it from View ▸ Tool Windows ▸ Test Data Playground. Uses the same validated engine as the Kassi Test Data generator.
